bayts.text: O you who honour the guest, whether neighbour or visitor, O you who effaced from a servant, already before, the burdens (of sins),
your servant called you on land, after the sea, and today you led to him, through Allah, what he chose.
You honoured him with the hospitality of an affair and an honour, and he obtained, against all evils, veils.
You freed him already before from all but good pleasure, as you adorned him with the wishes of the two Abodes, most dutiful.
Through you his journey to Allah has reached its end, well pleased with you; and he has already obtained lights and secrets.
You made him safe from misery, triumphant forever, an intimate and a beloved for you: he does not enter the Fire.
He attained the wishes with a clarity after which there is no turbidity, from Him Who bought from him, by the sea, a dīnār.
From him Allah has bought (and removed) every envious adversary, wherever he turned, forever, as He led to him what he desires of needs.
The Accursed turned back, despairing of him, going away, and all wherein is harm has crept elsewhere.
Toward others than him Iblīs makes, forever: your Lord has spared him conjectures and turbidities.
You are the Prophet, the Messenger, the Chosen, the banner: may He bless you Whose preference (for you) has already circled (around you).
Truly I am your neighbour, O best of creation, forever: may He grant you peace to Whom all of me has come to belong.
May an Everlasting One with no partner bless you and grant you peace, O you through whom He led helpers to me.
You led my request to me, you met my need, you effaced from me, before today, the burdens (of sins).
